+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+from gettext import ngettext
+
+from .types import Tuple
+
+if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from .core import Context
+    from .core import Parameter
+
+
+class ListCompositeValues(Tuple):
+    """A :class:`Tuple` type that returns the converted values as a
+    list instead of a tuple.
+    """
+
+    def convert(
+        self, value: t.Any, param: Parameter | None, ctx: Context | None
+    ) -> t.Any:
+        len_type = len(self.types)
+        len_value = len(value)
+
+        if len_value != len_type:
+            self.fail(
+                ngettext(
+                    "{len_type} values are required, but {len_value} was given.",
+                    "{len_type} values are required, but {len_value} were given.",
+                    len_value,
+                ).format(len_type=len_type, len_value=len_value),
+                param=param,
+                ctx=ctx,
+            )
+
+        return [ty(x, param, ctx) for ty, x in zip(self.types, value, strict=False)]
diff --git a/tests/test_list_composite_values.py b/tests/test_list_composite_values.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1ab9954
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_list_composite_values.py
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.list_composite_values import ListCompositeValues
+
+
+def test_convert_returns_list():
+    ty = ListCompositeValues([int, str])
+    assert ty.convert(("1", "a"), None, None) == [1, "a"]
+
+
+def test_arity_mismatch():
+    ty = ListCompositeValues([int, int])
+
+    with pytest.raises(click.BadParameter, match="2 values are required"):
+        ty.convert(("1",), None, None)
+
+
+def test_option(runner):
+    @click.command()
+    @click.option("--pair", type=ListCompositeValues([int, str]))
+    def cli(pair):
+        click.echo(repr(pair))
+
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["--pair", "1", "a"])
+    assert result.output == "[1, 'a']\n"
